evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark report describes continuing failures on expert knowledge and reasoning questions across frontier models, including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and o1. It also acknowledges improvements over earlier models.
OpenAI reported improved research-mathematics performance. This qualifies any suggestion of stagnation, while remaining consistent with the narrower claim that reasoning problems persisted.

unresolved_gaps: These evaluations do not isolate the causal contribution of pretraining scale from data, architecture, post-training, or inference methods.
